report.summary: Chunk 2 of 9: constants, exception classes, dataclass JournalEntry, and journal reading functions (_prefix_hasher, complete_prefix_end, journal_position, scan_journal).
risks: scan_journal | medium | scan_journal reads lines but does not populate 'record' or 'error' fields; they remain None. Callers may expect parsed data. | Check if the caller or later chunk fills these fields.
complete_prefix_end | low | If file is empty, returns 0; if file has no newlines, loops to 0 and returns 0. That's correct but edge case. | No action needed.

claims.text: DEFAULT_DIMENSION: Output width of ``nomic-embed-text``, measured on both hosts.  Only used when no index exists yet and the caller declared nothing; a backend that disagrees fails loudly in ``_validate_batch`` rather than being padded or truncated.
claims.why: Claim refers to _validate_batch and backend behavior not in this chunk.

claims.text: ProjectionWorkerError: Base class for refusals raised before any vector is written.
claims.why: Class inherits RuntimeError; docstring describes its purpose.

claims.text: SpecConflictError: The declared spec disagrees with an index already in this database.
claims.why: Class inherits ProjectionWorkerError; docstring describes conflict.

claims.text: JournalEntry: One newline-terminated journal line and the byte offset just past it.
claims.why: Fields line_number, start_offset, end_offset, raw, record, error match description.

claims.text: _prefix_hasher: Stream ``[0, position)`` into a live SHA-256, or ``None`` if it is short.
claims.why: Code opens file, reads chunks up to position, updates hasher, returns None if chunk is empty (file shorter than watermark).

claims.text: complete_prefix_end: Byte offset just past the last newline-terminated line. Bytes after this point are a partial line -- a writer mid-append -- and are deliberately not journal content yet.
claims.why: Code scans from end backwards using _TAIL_CHUNK to find last newline; returns offset after it. If no newline, returns 0.

claims.text: journal_position: The journal's current position, in the measure this worker records. Callers that want an honest ``freshness`` out of :meth:`EventVectorStore.search_report` must pass *this* value: a watermark and an observation only compare if they use the same measure.
claims.why: Refers to EventVectorStore.search_report, not in this chunk.

claims.text: scan_journal: Read complete lines from ``start``, at most ``limit`` of them.
claims.why: Code does not enforce 'limit' parameter; it reads all lines from start. The limit parameter is ignored.

claims.text: scan_journal: for raw in handle: if not raw.endswith(b"\n"): break  # partial trailing line: not a record yet
claims.why: Code checks for newline-ending; breaks if not.

observations.what: scan_journal ignores the 'limit' parameter; reads all lines from start.
scan_journal does not populate 'record' or 'error' fields; they remain None.
complete_prefix_end returns 0 for empty file or file with no newlines; correct.
journal_position returns hash of empty string when file doesn't exist or hasher is None.
